title: AI assistant
intro: Drafts the summary of a session and suggests the follow-up actions its minutes call for. The host reviews everything before it is saved.
keyHint: Create a key in the Anthropic console. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
keySaved: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
instanceKeyHint: This instance provides a key. Type your own to use your Anthropic account instead.
noEncryption: Keys cannot be stored: SECRET_KEY is not set on this instance.
privacy: When someone asks for it, the minutes of the session (never the check-ins before the session, never the passwords or keys) are sent to Anthropic to write the answer.
